title: Three facts that end the debate early
prompt: Open each constraint before you design around it.

hotspots.label: Remote MCP servers are fully supported for Assistant
hotspots.detail: If the requirement is Assistant-side tool access over an open standard, remote MCP servers are fully supported.

hotspots.label: In Agents, MCP-backed tools work in Plan and Execute and auto mode
hotspots.detail: MCP-backed tools are available in Plan and Execute mode and in auto mode, which is where dynamic tool choice belongs.

hotspots.label: MCP tools are not individual single-step selections in Agent Builder
hotspots.detail: You cannot pick an MCP tool as a single discrete step in Agent Builder. If the design needs one fixed deterministic step, that is a custom action.
